name: zeffect_anim_reset_activation_prereq_count
description: zEffectAnim::ResetActivationPrereqCount clears the animation entry activation-prerequisite count byte.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect animation source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x45d7a0 validates a leaf fastcall write of zero to byte offset 0x10b, matching zEffectAnimEntry::activationPrereqCount.

The native zEffect prerequisite smoke initializes activationPrereqCount to a nonzero value, calls ResetActivationPrereqCount, verifies the count is zero, and verifies the reset enables the zero-prerequisite success path through CheckActivationPrereqs.
